title: ChroSpin - ProteinG
author: David Frommholz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pyfdptn
materials: Do you want to purify antibodies or sanitize your column? Please choose below.

steps.title: Prepare and load sample
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample to pH 7‑8 and 150‑300 mM NaCl (add 1/11 volume 10× PBS), ensure antibody concentration is 2‑3 mg per sample, add up to 500 µL of the sample to the top of the ChroSpin‑Protein G column and incubate with end‑over‑end mixing or occasional inversion for 3 min (30 s for fast‑binding antibodies, up to 10 min for slow‑binding antibodies; longer times increase background).

steps.title: Collect flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g, place the column into a clean receiver tube and keep the flow‑through and wash fractions for later analysis (e.g., SDS‑PAGE).

steps.title: First wash of column
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL wash buffer to the column, close the lid, invert the column 5 times, then centrifuge for 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g and discard the receiver tube.

substeps.instruction: If nonspecific hydrophobic or ionic interactions are observed, include up to 1 % Tween‑20 and/or up to 0.5 M NaCl in the wash buffer.

steps.title: First elution
steps.instruction: Place the column into a clean receiver tube, add 200 µL elution buffer, close the lid, invert the column three times and centrifuge for 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g.

steps.title: Second elution
steps.instruction: Repeat the previous step: add another 200 µL elution buffer, invert three times and centrifuge 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g.

steps.title: Neutralize eluate
steps.instruction: Add two drops of neutralization solution to the combined eluate and mix gently.

steps.title: Optional additional washes for purity
steps.instruction: Remove the bottom cap, centrifuge the column for 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g to discard any storage solution (if the column was previously stored), then add 500 µL wash buffer, invert sharply 3‑5 times and centrifuge 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g.

substeps.instruction: Repeat this wash step up to 5 times for increased purity, then proceed to the post‑purification cleaning step.
Add 500 µL elution buffer and centrifuge 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g.
Add 500 µL wash buffer and centrifuge 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g.
Add 500 µL deionized water and centrifuge 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g.
Close the bottom of the column, add 500 µL 20 % ethanol **or** wash buffer containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide, close the lid and store the column at room temperature or 4‑8 °C.

For long‑term storage, dry the open (top and bottom) column in an oven at 80 °C for at least 2 hours (or overnight), ensure the bottom stopper is completely dry, re‑attach the column outlet and store the closed column at room temperature.

steps.title: Sanitize column (if required)
steps.instruction: Close the bottom of the column, add 500 µL sanitization solution, close the lid and incubate for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Final water rinse
steps.instruction: Remove the bottom cap, centrifuge the column for 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g, then wash three times with 500 µL deionized water, centrifuging 30‑60 seconds at 1000 g after each wash.

steps.title: Prepare column for storage
steps.instruction: Close the bottom of the column, add 500 µL wash buffer containing 0.05 % (w/v) sodium azide, close the lid and store the column at room temperature or 4‑8 °C; wait at least 12 hours before the next purification.

substeps.instruction: For long‑term storage, follow the drying procedure described in step 8.
